archive_key_note: debian-ports rotates its archive signing key, so a snapshot older than the keyring shipped in the resolver image fails signature verification rather than expiry. A timestamp is pinned together with the keyring vintage that can verify it.
comment: One archive state and one base image identify a build. The resolver that schedules the build, the guest APT configuration, the source downloads, and the package builder all read this file, because a timestamp recorded in one of them and not the others reproduces nothing. builder_base.sha256 stays empty until the base image exists; the runner refuses an unpinned or absent base rather than building against whatever is present.
